notes: Devin CLI requires a real Cognition account API key — server-validated, no self-hosted/BYOK option. Agent defect worth knowing: authenticate (devin-browser PKCE) never answers headless-with-browser and wedges the serialized dispatch queue — on a credentialed desktop host the whole suite times out. The probe authenticates last so the wedge can't swallow the suite; credentialed score ~58 vs 40 here.
